app.subtitle: Local competition desk
app.footer: Trusted local PC only. No cloud. Sporting configuration remains the organizer's responsibility.

event.timezone_help: All times use this event timezone. Language changes do not change competition times.
time.choose_occurrence: Choose which occurrence of this time
time.ambiguous: This time occurs twice during the clock change. Choose an occurrence, then save again.
time.nonexistent: This local time does not exist during the clock change. Choose another time.

punch.exclusion_reason: Why should this punch be excluded? The original punch stays unchanged.
ranking.heading: Category standings
rfid.label: RFID tag
rfid.manual_help: Fallback only: enter the tag's hexadecimal UID. Leave blank to remove its assignment.
rfid.unknown_help: Select a participant and confirm assignment. Their earlier punches in this event are recalculated automatically.
rfid.waiting: Waiting for the next unassigned live RFID tag… Punch the tag at a FoxIdent station.
rfid.confirm_message: Assign tag {uid} to start number {number} ({name}) and save this participant? Earlier punches for this tag in the current event will be reinterpreted.
rfid.replace_message: This replaces tag {old_uid}. Both tag histories will be reinterpreted and the change recorded.
rfid.assigned: RFID tag assigned. Earlier event punches have been recalculated.
rfid.no_connection: Connect FoxIdentServer to read a new tag, or select a recently seen tag.
rfid.stale: This tag is no longer available. Refresh the recent tags or read another tag.
rfid.other_owner: This tag belongs to another active participant. Edit that participant and deliberately clear their tag first; FoxLive will not move it silently.
rfid.timed_out: No tag detected. Try again or select a recently seen tag.
csv.heading: Participant CSV
csv.help: UTF-8 CSV: start_number means Start number; first_name/last_name identify the runner; category is an enabled event category code. Supply birth_year or birth_date. Optional: uid (event RFID tag), club, club_code (DOK), start_time. Unique matching people/clubs are reused; ambiguous identities require manual registration. Imports are atomic and never overwrite entries. CSV start_time uses ISO 8601.
csv.utf8: The file is not valid UTF-8. Save it as UTF-8 CSV and try again.
history.heading: Change history

debug.associate_confirm: Associate these {count} historical punches with this event and recalculate? The originals stay unchanged.
debug.help: Historical selection is deliberate. Select punches by tag, station and time, not by database numbers. Raw technical details remain untranslated.

master.heading: Reusable runners, clubs and categories
master.help: Person data is reusable. Each registration keeps its own start number, category and tag. Existing event labels remain unchanged when reusable data is edited.

runner.search: Search name, birth year or club / DOK
runner.birth_required: Enter a birth year or full birth date.
club.heading: Clubs / DOKs
category.available: Select reusable category for this event
category.review: Legacy category: check both language names and conflicting codes
registration.heading: Register participant
registration.help: Select an existing runner or create a person here, then set the event start number, category and RFID tag. Birth data never chooses the category automatically.
registration.new_only: Use Register participant to register a new runner; edit reusable person data in Master data.
error.runner_registered: This runner is already registered in this event.
error.birth_future: Birth information cannot be in the future.
error.birth_mismatch: Birth year does not match the full birth date.
error.club_exists: This club code / DOK already exists.
error.category_disabled: This category is not enabled for the event.
error.category_selection: Enable another category instead of replacing an existing event category.
error.runner_ambiguous: More than one person matches. Select the runner manually.
error.csv_runner_repeat: This runner occurs twice in the CSV. Register ambiguous people manually.
error.club_ambiguous: More than one club matches. Select the club manually.
error.club_mismatch: Club code and club name do not match.
event.workflow_help: Enable categories, register participants and configure stations before starting the event.
event.confirm_state: Set this event to {state}? Live punch processing will stop.
category.selection_help: Select the reusable categories available for registration in this event.
category.create_enable: Create and enable for this event
category.commit_help: This explicitly creates reusable category data and enables it for this event, even if you later cancel registration.
system.base_help: Connection and time synchronization are managed by FoxCore. Configure the source in the local TOML file.
system.settings_help: Language is a browser preference. HTTP binding, source and database settings are configured in TOML; changing them requires a restart.
registration.confirm_deactivate: Deactivate #{number} {name}? The registration and its punch history will be retained, but no longer score.
registration.empty: No participants registered yet. Register the first participant or import a CSV file.
club.label: Club / DOK
club.staging_help: During new-runner registration, this club is saved together with the runner and registration. Canceling registration discards it.
club.exact_match: This club already exists. Select it instead of creating a duplicate.
club.similar_matches: Similar clubs exist. Review them before creating a new club.
runner.possible_matches: Possible existing runners. Select a person or explicitly create a different runner.
error.processing: Processing stopped. Check System → Diagnostics before continuing.
error.club_similar: Review similar existing clubs before creating a new club.
error.club_choice: Select an existing club or create a new club, not both.
display.title: Live display
display.empty: Results and punches will appear here when the event is running.
readout.provider_pending: Reader integration pending. Import a captured tag file or use the software simulator below. USB tag-reader integration is not yet available.
readout.simulator_help: Select a participant or enter an unassigned tag, choose station files and their actual punch times. This creates TAG evidence only, never live radio punches.
readout.statistics: Readouts: {readouts} · Recovered controls: {recovered} · Open reviews: {reviews} · Manual decisions: {manual}
readout.summary: Live controls: {live} · Tag controls: {tag} · Recovered: {recovered} · Matches: {matches} · Reviews: {reviews}
readout.retry: Read again after a partial/failed/aborted read. Missing files are not evidence of a missed control.
readout.too_large: The capture must not exceed 1 MiB.
review.help: Compare independent live, tag and manual evidence. Decisions require a reason and never change source records.
review.heading: Review / adjudication
review.choose_evidence: Select one valid live or tag observation first.
review.confirm_decision: Apply this result-affecting decision with the stated reason? Previous evidence and decisions will be retained.
review.confirm_close: {count} review cases remain open. Close with explicitly provisional results?
evidence.UNTRUSTED_LIVE_TIME: Live time matches an unsynchronized tag record
evidence.EXCLUDED_LIVE_MATCH: Tag matches a manually excluded live punch
evidence.PRESENCE: Control counted without trusting its time
review.error_action: This adjudication action is not supported.
review.error_station: The station must be enabled for this event.
review.error_presence: Ignoring the timestamp is only allowed for controls, not Start or Finish.
review.error_time: The manual time fails event timestamp or time-window validation.
review.error_select: Select valid current evidence, or enter an explicit manual time.
review.error_close: Open review cases remain. Confirm closing with provisional results.
readout.error_event: Configure the embedded tag event number before using the simulator.
readout.error_capture: Select a valid capture file to import.
readout.error_scenario: This readout scenario is not supported.
